provenance.annotationMethod: Original English annotations from visual inspection of all 576 acquired images; eight filename-defined strata, 72 images each. Keywords are visual descriptions, not authoritative spell/item names.
provenance.selectionRule: Within each filename-defined stratum, ascending SHA256(lowercase originalPath); first 120 fetched; first 72 successful distinct image hashes selected; deterministic top-up from reserves to 576 if needed
provenance.identityLimit: Filename match does not prove pixel identity with a specific installed client FileDataID; no client archive was extracted and no runtime provider catalogue was exported
provenance.coverage: Broad WoW community listfile sample; NOT an exported native Forever picker catalogue
provenance.artDisposition: Images and contact sheets are not redistributed. Only original text annotations and identity/provenance metadata are included.

records.notes: Community-source image mapping only; native client texture-id pixel identity is not proven. Sheet paths are relative to the session files root.
